title: Retry button calls request() when the status is BLOCKED
notes: The reported symptom is the giveaway. Status is collapsed to a boolean, so BLOCKED and DENIED are indistinguishable. On iOS, once the user has declined, request() resolves immediately without showing a prompt — so the Allow button genuinely does nothing, forever. The fix is to branch on the status and offer Linking.openSettings() for BLOCKED. Three secondary issues: LIMITED is treated as not granted (an iOS user who granted limited photo access would be blocked from a feature they enabled — here it matters as a pattern), the status is never re-checked on AppState resume so a user who grants in Settings returns to a screen still saying denied, and the dead-end UI offers no alternative path. Tests whether the agent connects the symptom to the state collapse rather than proposing generic permission advice.
